_comment: required_checks: checks agent-gate requires to have reported green on the PR head, in addition to every other check present; keep in sync with HomelabServer scripts/github/apply-merge-policy.sh. 'Zephyr / Firmware Build' is skipped (counts green) when no firmware input changed. owner_approval_label / owner_approval_paths: a PR touching these paths (fnmatch, '*' crosses '/') needs explicit owner approval whatever its class. reviewer_logins (optional): only these accounts may post review verdicts.
